requiredFindings.title: Installation-target copies are allocated beyond disclosure_cost
requiredFindings.failureScenario: mint_intent clones the home into installation_target before any charge for that buffer. deliver_disclosure then allocates the notice and a second PathBuf of the same target, while disclosure_cost reserves one object and target.len()+160. The notice fits that byte reserve (fixed text is 111 to 117 bytes). The two path buffers do not. used() stays at the short reserve, so a later charge can pass a budget the allocations have already exceeded. recheck_target allocates installation_target again with no charge.

requiredFindings.title: A target mismatch does not latch the attempt
requiredFindings.failureScenario: recheck_target returns IntentRefusal::TargetChanged when the actor lineage or the account-derived target differs from the disclosed root, and it does not latch the owning attempt. run still accepts later work on that attempt, so the before-effect refusal does not stop the act.

scope: 464 code: creation-intent mint, constant UNKNOWN disclosure, installation entry table, and positive absence. Not creator enablement.
